title: OpenAI says its internal model solved over 100 long-standing math problems after just a month of training
summary: OpenAI says a new internal model solved more than 100 open math problems after just a month of training. Facing criticism from mathematicians, the company is backing an independent advisory group at the Institute for Advanced Study. But OpenAI has excluded its research pace from the group's advisory role.
